title: Govt summons Meta again over temporary restriction of PM Modi's FB post
content: India's government has summoned Meta executives to explain a temporary restriction on Prime Minister Modi's video. The social media giant acknowledged the error and has restored the content. New protocols are being introduced for prominent public figures' accounts. This incident highlights ongoing scrutiny of content moderation by tech firms. The government seeks explanations for platform governance and content handling.

title: No further action against CJP protesters, Delhi govt says; criminal antecedents excluded
content: Delhi Police will not pursue further legal action against protest participants.  This order excludes individuals with existing criminal backgrounds.  The government is reviewing and expediting the release of detained protesters.  Thirteen cases were registered concerning the NEET paper leak protests.  The decision follows allegations of student harassment and threats of arrest.

title: Fleming takes over as England Test coach; ex-CSK boss begins new era with Root
content: Stephen Fleming has been appointed as England men's Test head coach. He replaces Brendon McCullum and will begin his tenure later this summer. Marcus Trescothick will serve as interim coach for the Pakistan series. Fleming expressed excitement about working with returning captain Joe Root. The new partnership aims to rebuild England's red-ball cricket fortunes.

title: UP horror: Landlord 'rapes' tenant's minor daughter repeatedly, records videos
content: Police reported a 10-year-old girl was allegedly raped by her landlord in Goverdhan. The accused, a 42-year-old West Bengal native, had assaulted the minor previously. The victim informed her mother after the incident on Wednesday. Police registered a case under BNS and POCSO sections. The girl has undergone medical examination and further legal action is pending.

title: NYC banned Motoclick, now Mamdani targets Uber Eats, DoorDash over "hidden" tip buttons
content: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says the city's crackdown on Uber Eats and DoorDash tipping practices has delivered $104 million in extra tips to delivery workers since January. A new DCWP report shows tips per delivery doubled from $1.18 to $2.29 after apps were forced to show tip buttons at checkout. Mamdani, who earlier moved to shut down Motoclick, warns more enforcement is coming.

title: E20 petrol can reduce vehicle mileage by up to 6%: Nitin Gadkari in Parliament
content: E20 petrol may reduce vehicle mileage by two to six percent. Extensive testing has found no engine failures linked to this fuel. Studies indicate improved acceleration and better ride quality with E20. Carbon emissions are reduced by approximately thirty percent compared to E10. Automobile manufacturers continue to honor warranty claims for vehicles using E20.

title: Kevin O'Leary says China's rise will unite US, Canada and Mexico
content: Kevin O'Leary suggests China's growing power will unite North American economies.  Canada offers minerals and energy, while the US provides scale and innovation.  Mexico also plays a vital role in the regional economic landscape.  Companies are increasingly using cheaper Chinese artificial intelligence models.  This shift occurs as the race for technological dominance accelerates globally.

title: 13-year-old turns peanut shells into pesticide remover, eyes $25K prize
content: Thirteen-year-old Minnesota student Arika Kundu has designed a method that uses discarded peanut shells to help remove pesticide residues from fresh fruits and vegetables. Her project, called LIGNEX, has made her one of 10 finalists in the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge. She will now compete for the $25,000 grand prize with guidance from a 3M scientist.

title: New Zealand invests $202M to restore three islands with Māori help
content: In an inspiring ecological restoration project, New Zealand is teaming up with Māori natives to tackle invasive mammal populations on three major islands, including Maukahuka, Rakiura, and the Chatham archipelago. This extensive collaboration among governmental bodies, local communities, and Indigenous organizations aims to breathe new life into native wildlife. The success of this project could highlight New Zealand's pioneering methods in environmental restoration on the world stage.

title: EPA expands electricity bill pledge signed by Google, Meta and Amazon
content: Tech giants pledge to cover energy costs for their facilities.  The Environmental Protection Agency expanded this pledge to include utilities and regulators.  New guidance exempts data centers not connected to the public grid from certain regulations.  This move aims to support artificial intelligence infrastructure development.  It also seeks to prevent higher electricity bills for American households.

title: Denied seat, student hacks IIT-Kanpur website to show his 'merit'
content: A BTech applicant hacked IIT Kanpur's website seeking admission consideration. He claimed he was denied a fair chance in the selection process. The IIT director invited the candidate to campus for an assessment. He stressed that hacking was not the correct approach to gain entry. The institute will consider him if genuine talent is demonstrated.

title: Who was Billy Ray Smith Jr? Chargers legend dies at 64 after remarkable career
content: Billy Ray Smith Jr., the former San Diego Chargers linebacker and College Football Hall of Famer, died at 64 after struggling with dementia caused by CTE. Here's everything to know about his life, from his childhood in Arkansas and standout college career to his decade in the NFL, his broadcasting journey, his wife, Kimberly Hunt, his family, and his lasting football legacy. The Chargers legend spent his entire professional career with the franchise and remained a respected voice in sports long after retirement.

title: Neeraj Chopra leads full Indian charge into javelin final; Rohit, Yash Vir qualify
content: Neeraj Chopra and two other Indian javelin throwers advanced to the medal round.  Rohit Yadav and Yash Vir Singh also secured their spots in the final contest.  Chopra focused on qualifying while managing his recovery from injury.  Difficult weather conditions affected all competitors during the qualification event.  The Indian contingent aims for podium finishes in the upcoming final.

title: Inside Villa Skyfall: James Bond-inspired $85 million Florida mansion hits the market
content: Introducing Villa Skyfall, an extraordinary mansion inspired by James Bond, available for a staggering $85 million. Nestled in the prestigious Stone Creek Ranch of Delray Beach, Florida, this opulent estate boasts nine luxurious bedrooms, an elegant grand salon adorned with crystal chandeliers, and even a concealed poker lounge. With its rainforest-inspired spa and included furnishings, buyers can experience immediate luxury living.

title: Beyond the cargo bay: The rise of transport aircraft as battlefield, rescue assets
content: Transport aircraft now perform diverse roles beyond basic cargo delivery.  These versatile platforms are crucial for combat and humanitarian relief operations.  Modern aircraft like the C-130 and C-390 offer multi-mission flexibility.  The Airbus A400M Atlas also bridges strategic and tactical capabilities effectively.  These adaptable aircraft serve as significant force multipliers in various scenarios.

content: ED recently took over the investigation to probe the source of funding for radicalisation and terror activities.

title: Why Indian hockey team jersey changed from blue to saffron: HI explains
content: Hockey India will use saffron jerseys for the 2026 World Cup. According to Hockey India, the traditional blue jersey blended with the blue artificial turf used in international hockey, making it difficult for players to spot teammates during matches. The federation said players and coaches suggested different colours before saffron was chosen.

title: TMC's Kalyan Banerjee wears poster with 20 rebel MPs' photos in Parliament

The Trinamool Congress has labeled these MPs as traitors for their actions. Rebel MPs had approached the Election Commission regarding the party split. A swift decision is needed to resolve the ongoing political uncertainty.

title: Jointly property ownership: What happens when co-owners disagree over rent or sale
content: A growing number of buyers are opting for shared homeownership to alleviate financial strain and share loan obligations. In various states, including a woman as a co-owner can unlock potential stamp duty reductions. However, this arrangement necessitates mutual consent for the sale of the property and any loan matters, with each co-owner entitled to sell their respective portion. Disputes between co-owners can result in negotiations, buyouts, or legal partitions.

title: Raghav Juyal opens up on 'Bhai Tera Star Hai', Govinda | Exclusive

Juyal notes a shift in industry perception after his role in the film Kill. He aims to offer audiences a dose of happiness through his comedy projects. Juyal also shares his views on being a protector and provider for women.

Teachers have also addressed unresolved issues related to employment conditions and salaries. Furthermore, the government intends to digitize petition tracking, underscoring the growing importance of school meals in shaping education policy and ensuring accountability.

title: Bengaluru has water reserves for only 4 months
content: Bengaluru's water supply is secure for the next four months. Reservoir storage levels are sufficient to meet the city's monthly water needs. Officials are monitoring groundwater and seeking reports on its status. Residents are urged to conserve water and avoid non-essential uses. Treated water should not be used for gardening or washing doorsteps.

title: From delivery rider to Rs 1 crore entrepreneur: How one accident changed his life

A serious road accident ended his delivery career but led him to discover writing through Pocket FM. Today, he is the lead writer of the hit audio-fiction series Brahmyodha: The Destroyer, has written over 1,000 episodes, and reportedly earned more than ₹1 crore through digital storytelling.

title: Will AI take your job? Cashiers to doctors, which professions face biggest risk
content: Artificial intelligence will automate routine jobs across many industries.  Complex tasks requiring human judgment will be supported by generative AI.  Financial services and retail trade see high automation risk for basic operations.  Healthcare and education will see AI strengthen clinical and learning roles.  Workplace tasks will be reshaped as AI complements human capabilities.

title: 'India ke liye ladne wala insaan': Tributes pour in as Ajinkya Rahane retires
content: Ajinkya Rahane represented India in 85 Tests, 90 ODIs and 20 T20Is. The Mumbai batter finished his Test career with 5,077 runs at an average of 38.46, including 12 centuries and 26 half-centuries. In ODIs, he scored 2,962 runs in 90 matches at an average of 35.26, with three centuries and 24 fifties. He also played 20 T20Is, scoring 375 runs.

title: UK announces £8.4 billion boost for Trident renewal under Dreadnought submarine programme
content: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has unveiled new agreements for the Dreadnought submarine initiative. This crucial investment is projected to generate thousands of employment opportunities and apprenticeships within the defence industry. The modernization of the Trident nuclear deterrent is pivotal to the government's defence framework, aimed at replacing the outdated Vanguard-class submarines with enhanced vessels, reinforcing both national security and economic revival.

title: We are in India, be realistic, says HC, lifts curbs on hotel over 2 insects

The court accepted the hotel's undertaking to maintain high sanitation standards.  The Food and Drug Administration's drive aims to improve food safety across Maharashtra.  The court appreciated the state and FDA actions in enforcing food safety laws.

title: US judges issue removal orders against 801 Indians in June

This indicates a faster disposal of immigration cases by US courts. Indian migrants, many from Gujarat and Punjab, face sustained enforcement actions. The data shows immigration courts are disposing of cases at a much faster pace.

title: Bihar man beheads sister-in-law over delay in serving food, hangs head from tree

He then allegedly hung her severed head from a banyan tree near his home. Villagers discovered the gruesome scene and alerted the local police. The accused was apprehended by villagers and handed over to the authorities.

title: Mirabai Chanu’s education journey behind her Commonwealth glory
content: Olympic medallist Mirabai Chanu’s journey shows that education extends beyond the classroom. While her demanding training limited traditional schooling, she pursued higher education through flexible learning while building resilience through real-life challenges. From carrying firewood in rural Manipur to overcoming Olympic heartbreak and injuries, Chanu transformed setbacks into strengths. Her perseverance culminated in a historic third consecutive Commonwealth Games gold medal in Glasgow 2026, highlighting the power of determination, continuous learning, and mental resilience.

title: Why electric cars may handle flooded roads better than petrol and diesel vehicles
content: Electric vehicles offer greater resilience in urban flooding situations.  Their sealed motors and battery packs prevent catastrophic engine damage common in petrol cars.  Modern EVs meet stringent waterproofing standards, minimizing electrical risks during waterlogged commutes.  While deep submersion poses risks for all vehicles, EVs are engineered to withstand typical flood conditions.  This engineering advantage makes them a more intelligent choice for India's changing weather patterns.
